title: “Jesus warned about this.”
paragraphs:
Truth:
One of the most sobering warnings in the Bible is that many people who think they belong to Jesus… actually don’t.

They say,
“Lord, Lord.”
They claim His name.
They even do religious things.

Scripture:
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven…”
— Matthew 7:21–23

Reality:
Knowing about Jesus is not the same as knowing Him.

Church attendance isn't the same as surrender.
Religious words aren't the same as obedience.

Question:
If Jesus examined your life today…
would He say “I know you”?
“Many people know the name of Jesus… but do they truly know Him?”

What do you think Jesus meant in Matthew 7:21–23?
👇 Let’s talk.
